title: Protocol for electron microscopy ultrastructural localization of the fusogenic lipid phosphatidic acid on plasma membrane sheets from chromaffin cells
protocol: Dilute stock fibronectin solution in water to obtain a fibronectin solution at 10 μg/mL.
Place cleaned and sterilized 12-mm coverslips in 4-well plates using sterile forceps.
Add 500 μL of 10 μg/mL fibronectin to each well containing a coverslip.
Spread the fibronectin solution evenly over the surface of the coverslips.
Incubate the plates at 37°C for at least 3 hours.
Remove fibronectin from the wells just before adding medium.
Isolate chromaffin cells from fresh bovine adrenal glands according to a previously described protocol.
Suspend the needed amount of freshly isolated chromaffin cells into 10 mL of DMEM-D medium in a 50 mL Falcon® tube.
Maintain cells at 37°C until use.
Perform electroporation as soon as possible after cell isolation.
Add 400 μL of DMEM-D medium to each well of 4-well plates containing fibronectin-coated coverslips and place the plates at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Equilibrate transfection buffer at room temperature.
Thaw an aliquot of Spo20p-GFP plasmid at room temperature.
Prepare 2 μg of plasmid in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube using an endotoxin-free plasmid purification kit.
Determine the concentration of plasmid preparation by optical density measurement.
Aliquot prepared plasmid before storage at -20°C.
Centrifuge previously prepared cell aliquots at 100 g, 5 minutes at room temperature.
Entirely discard the supernatant.
Gently resuspend the pellet with 100 μL of transfection buffer for 7.5 × 10^6 cells using a 1000 μL micropipette.
Add 100 μL of suspended cells to each 1.5 mL tube containing plasmid and gently mix.
Transfer the mixture into an electroporation cuvette with a single-use pipette.
Insert the cuvette into the Nucleofector device and electroporate cells using the Amaxa nucleofector program X-001.
Immediately after electroporation, add 500 μL of DMEM-D medium to each cuvette.
Gently resuspend cells and collect suspension with a single-use pipette.
Plate cells by adding 4–6 drops (each drop ≈25 μL) to each well already containing 400 μL of warmed DMEM-D medium and mix gently.
Incubate cells at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Add 1:1 (vol to vol) of pre-warmed DMEM-C2 medium to each well (500–550 μL).
Pre-warm Locke’s and high K+ depolarizing solutions in a water bath set to 37°C.
Place cells onto a hot plate set at 37°C.
Aspirate medium from wells.
Wash cells three times with Locke’s solution (1 mL per well).
Add 500 μL of high K+ depolarizing solution or Locke’s solution per well for stimulation.
Incubate cells for 10 minutes at 37°C.
Prepare material required for preparation of plasma membrane sheets during the 10 min stimulation step.
Incubate coverslip exposing Formvar-coated EM grids in solution.
Flip the coverslip onto cells.
Place cork above the coverslips and press slightly for 20–25 s.
Rapidly dissociate the coverslips with two forceps.
Lift the coverslip carrying grids to expose membrane sheets on the upper side.
Promote cell adhesion to the Formvar film quickly (typically in less than 30 s).
Transfer coverslip carrying grids to a well containing 2% ice-cold PFA and fix sheets for 10 min at room temperature.
Remove fixative from wells and wash 6 times with 500 μl of PBS per well at room temperature.
Incubate sheets with 400 μl of blocking solution per well overnight at 4°C.
Incubate sheets with primary antibodies (rabbit anti-GFP).
Prepare a 1:100 dilution of the primary antibody in the blocking solution.
Retrieve coverslips from wells using forceps and place them on raised supports in a humidity chamber.
Add 50 μL of primary antibody dilution onto each coverslip.
Incubate for 4 hours at room temperature to avoid sample drying.
After incubation, replace coverslips in wells containing PBS.
Gently wash the coverslips 6 times with 500 μL of PBS per well at room temperature.
Prepare a 1% solution of secondary antibody (15 nm gold particle-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG) in blocking solution.
Remove PBS from wells and add 400 μL of secondary antibody dilution per well.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Use secondary antibodies with different diameter gold particles if several primary antibodies have been used simultaneously.
Remove secondary antibody solution and gently wash six times with 500 μL of PBS per well at room temperature.
Incubate samples with 400 μL per well of 2.5% ice-cold glutaraldehyde solution for 2 hours at 2°C–8°C.
Postfix with 0.5% OsO4 solution for 45 minutes to 1 hour at room temperature after removing fixative and rinsing in sodium cacodylate buffer.
Remove fixative from wells and rinse with sterile ultrapure water for the same duration as osmium post-fixation at room temperature.
Dehydrate samples by incubating with a graded series of ethanol (25%, 50%, 70%, 95%, and 100%), each for 15 minutes.
Incubate samples with 400 μL per well of HMDS - ethanol 50%/50% solution for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate samples with 400 μL per well of HMDS for two times, each for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Air-dry samples overnight under the chemical hood.
Mount the grid in a standard TEM holder.
Insert the holder into the TEM.
Scan the grid at low magnification (× 25,000) to find stained sheets with docked secretory granules.
Acquire at least 30 images per condition at high magnification (× 60,000).
